title: The 'E' and 'D' keys on my keyboard aren't working
description: When I try to type quickly, these two keys stick or don't work at all.

worklogs.description: Cleaned with compressed air, partially fixed.
Provided a spare keyboard, user tested all the keys.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: A spare keyboard was provided for you to use. We sent your old keyboard to service.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: The new keyboard works without any issues, thank you very much.

resolutionNote: Spare keyboard delivered, the faulty keyboard sent to service for repair.
